notes_for_editor: Only two sources say anything useful: TN Landforms (name, county, elevation, standing) and the 2014 extant list in the NRHP multiple property document. No build date, design, height, owner or access rule was found, and web searches returned only genealogy pages. The record's NGS register entry (state number GC 2588) rests on the TN Landforms code 'GC2588'; no source we read confirms it as an NGS designation. Agency is left out because the document does not name an owner for this tower. Next steps: a TDF records request or a county newspaper search for construction and fire history.
